@@ -0,0 +1,93 @@
+from __future__ import absolute_import, division, print_function
+
+import gzip
+import io
+from email.message import Message
+
+import pytest
+
+from ansible.module_utils.urls import GzipDecodedReader, Request, fetch_url
+
+
+class Response(io.BytesIO):
+    def __init__(self, body, encoding=None):
+        super(Response, self).__init__(body)
+        self.headers = Message()
+        self.headers['Content-Length'] = str(len(body))
+        if encoding:
+            self.headers['Content-Encoding'] = encoding
+        self.code = 200
+
+    def info(self):
+        return self.headers
+
+    def geturl(self):
+        return 'http://example.test/data'
+
+
+def compressed(body):
+    stream = io.BytesIO()
+    with gzip.GzipFile(fileobj=stream, mode='wb') as writer:
+        writer.write(body)
+    return stream.getvalue()
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('decompress,encoding', [
+    (True, 'gzip'), (False, 'gzip'), (True, None), (False, None),
+])
+def test_request_stream_and_headers(mocker, decompress, encoding):
+    body = b'{"message":"hello"}' * 100
+    wire_body = compressed(body) if encoding else body
+    response = Response(wire_body, encoding)
+    urlopen = mocker.patch('ansible.module_utils.urls.urllib_request.urlopen', return_value=response)
+
+    result = Request(decompress=decompress).open('GET', 'http://example.test/data')
+    assert isinstance(result, GzipDecodedReader) == (decompress and encoding == 'gzip')
+    assert result.read(5) + result.read() == (body if decompress and encoding else wire_body)
+    assert urlopen.call_args[0][0].get_header('Accept-encoding') == ('gzip' if decompress else 'identity')
+    result.close()
+    assert response.closed
+
+
+def test_request_instance_defaults_and_explicit_header(mocker):
+    response = Response(compressed(b'data'), 'gzip')
+    urlopen = mocker.patch('ansible.module_utils.urls.urllib_request.urlopen', return_value=response)
+    request = Request(decompress=False, unredirected_headers=['Authorization'])
+    result = request.open('GET', 'http://example.test/data', headers={'Accept-Encoding': 'br', 'Authorization': 'token'})
+    sent = urlopen.call_args[0][0]
+    assert sent.get_header('Accept-encoding') == 'br'
+    assert sent.unredirected_hdrs['Authorization'] == 'token'
+    assert result.read() != b'data'
+
+
+def test_fetch_url_decoded_stream_and_lowercase_headers(mocker):
+    body = b'x' * 20000
+    wire_body = compressed(body)
+    mocker.patch('ansible.module_utils.urls.urllib_request.urlopen', return_value=Response(wire_body, 'gzip'))
+    module = mocker.Mock()
+    module.params = {}
+    module.tmpdir = None
+
+    response, info = fetch_url(module, 'http://example.test/data')
+    assert response.read() == body
+    assert info['content-encoding'] == 'gzip'
+    assert info['content-length'] == str(len(wire_body))
+    assert 'Content-Encoding' not in info
+
+
+def test_fetch_url_without_gzip_disables_decompression(mocker):
+    mocker.patch('ansible.module_utils.urls.gzip', None)
+    open_url = mocker.patch('ansible.module_utils.urls.open_url')
+    module = mocker.Mock()
+    module.params = {}
+    module.tmpdir = None
+    fetch_url(module, 'http://example.test/data')
+    module.deprecate.assert_called_once()
+    assert module.deprecate.call_args[1]['version'] == '2.16'
+    assert open_url.call_args[1]['decompress'] is False
+
+
+def test_missing_gzip_reader_error(mocker):
+    mocker.patch('ansible.module_utils.urls.gzip', None)
+    with pytest.raises(Exception, match='gzip'):
+        GzipDecodedReader(Response(b'', 'gzip'))

+from __future__ import absolute_import, division, print_function
+
+import gzip
+import io
+from email.message import Message
+
+import pytest
+
+from ansible.module_utils.urls import GzipDecodedReader, Request, fetch_url
+
+
+class Response(io.BytesIO):
+    def __init__(self, body, encoding=None):
+        super(Response, self).__init__(body)
+        self.headers = Message()
+        self.headers['Content-Length'] = str(len(body))
+        if encoding:
+            self.headers['Content-Encoding'] = encoding
+        self.code = 200
+
+    def info(self):
+        return self.headers
+
+    def geturl(self):
+        return 'http://example.test/data'
+
+
+def compressed(body):
+    stream = io.BytesIO()
+    with gzip.GzipFile(fileobj=stream, mode='wb') as writer:
+        writer.write(body)
+    return stream.getvalue()
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('decompress,encoding', [
+    (True, 'gzip'), (False, 'gzip'), (True, None), (False, None),
+])
+def test_request_stream_and_headers(mocker, decompress, encoding):
+    body = b'{"message":"hello"}' * 100
+    wire_body = compressed(body) if encoding else body
+    response = Response(wire_body, encoding)
+    urlopen = mocker.patch('ansible.module_utils.urls.urllib_request.urlopen', return_value=response)
+
+    result = Request(decompress=decompress).open('GET', 'http://example.test/data')
+    assert isinstance(result, GzipDecodedReader) == (decompress and encoding == 'gzip')
+    assert result.read(5) + result.read() == (body if decompress and encoding else wire_body)
+    assert urlopen.call_args[0][0].get_header('Accept-encoding') == ('gzip' if decompress else 'identity')
+    result.close()
+    assert response.closed
+
+
+def test_request_instance_defaults_and_explicit_header(mocker):
+    response = Response(compressed(b'data'), 'gzip')
+    urlopen = mocker.patch('ansible.module_utils.urls.urllib_request.urlopen', return_value=response)
+    request = Request(decompress=False, unredirected_headers=['Authorization'])
+    result = request.open('GET', 'http://example.test/data', headers={'Accept-Encoding': 'br', 'Authorization': 'token'})
+    sent = urlopen.call_args[0][0]
+    assert sent.get_header('Accept-encoding') == 'br'
+    assert sent.unredirected_hdrs['Authorization'] == 'token'
+    assert result.read() != b'data'
+
+
+def test_fetch_url_decoded_stream_and_lowercase_headers(mocker):
+    body = b'x' * 20000
+    wire_body = compressed(body)
+    mocker.patch('ansible.module_utils.urls.urllib_request.urlopen', return_value=Response(wire_body, 'gzip'))
+    module = mocker.Mock()
+    module.params = {}
+    module.tmpdir = None
+
+    response, info = fetch_url(module, 'http://example.test/data')
+    assert response.read() == body
+    assert info['content-encoding'] == 'gzip'
+    assert info['content-length'] == str(len(wire_body))
+    assert 'Content-Encoding' not in info
+
+
+def test_fetch_url_without_gzip_disables_decompression(mocker):
+    mocker.patch('ansible.module_utils.urls.gzip', None)
+    open_url = mocker.patch('ansible.module_utils.urls.open_url')
+    module = mocker.Mock()
+    module.params = {}
+    module.tmpdir = None
+    fetch_url(module, 'http://example.test/data')
+    module.deprecate.assert_called_once()
+    assert module.deprecate.call_args[1]['version'] == '2.16'
+    assert open_url.call_args[1]['decompress'] is False
+
+
+def test_missing_gzip_reader_error(mocker):
+    mocker.patch('ansible.module_utils.urls.gzip', None)
+    with pytest.raises(Exception, match='gzip'):
+        GzipDecodedReader(Response(b'', 'gzip'))
